tool.name: Liquidity Intelligence
tool.question: Is liquidity entering or leaving crypto, and is institutional capital entering or leaving through spot ETFs and corporate treasuries?

public_api.key_issuance: Free key on request: use the Give Feedback button on the site and choose Other. Keys are issued by hand and expire after 365 days.

endpoints.summary: Limits, endpoints and datasets of this API
Latest Liquidity Score, state, zone and inputs
Daily Liquidity Score and state for recent days
Institutional flow state, coverage and evidence
Daily 7 and 30 day spot ETF net flow sums for recent days

datasets.description: Liquidity Score (0-100), state (Expanding, Stable, Draining) and zone
